answer: Bind confidential-data access to one owner-level privacy budget, not agent IDs: before each paid query, debit the same differential-privacy allowance across every key serving that owner, and deny requests once it is spent. Thus aliases cannot reset access limits. A harbor agent might analyze nectar from a grove before scheduling wharf shipments. Proposed privacy-ledger fee: $0.01 per identity × 1,000 = $10, versus a proposed $0.01 one-time check for one honest agent. Limitation: this blocks budget-reset attacks only where data owners enforce the shared ledger.
